# Organizations

This folder catalogs the institutional landscape of the Danish healthcare system as it relates to ADHD assessment, treatment, and quality monitoring. It groups the organizations responsible for governance, data infrastructure, and clinical standards alongside the regional authorities, hospitals, and specialized psychiatric clinics that directly deliver patient care. Together, these sub-folders map the entire organizational ecosystem—from national steering committees and quality databases to local municipal authorities and individual outpatient departments—highlighting their respective roles, compliance rates, and systemic challenges in Danish ADHD care.

## Pages

- [[entities/organizations/clinics/index|Clinics]] — Specialized psychiatric assessment clinics focusing on child and adolescent ADHD diagnostics and their compliance with national standardized procedures.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-databases/index|Healthcare Databases]] — National registers and quality databases that form the data infrastructure for monitoring ADHD care and tracking clinical indicators.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-governance/index|Healthcare Governance]] — Steering committees and national statistical agencies responsible for overarching quality management, auditing, and foundational data provision.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-professional-bodies/index|Healthcare Professional Bodies]] — Medical societies and professional partnerships that develop evidence-based clinical guidelines and standards for psychiatric care.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-providers/index|Healthcare Providers]] — Public regional services and private hospitals delivering psychiatric care, detailing their compliance and data registration performance.
- [[entities/organizations/healthcare-standards/index|Healthcare Standards]] — Technical and administrative institutes driving clinical quality development and publishing national quality reports for ADHD treatment.
- [[entities/organizations/hospitals/index|Hospitals]] — Major institutional hubs and university hospital psychiatric divisions serving as central clinical reference centers for ADHD treatment.
- [[entities/organizations/psychiatry-clinics/index|Psychiatry Clinics]] — Specialized outpatient clinics and departments across Denmark evaluated against specific clinical quality indicators in national reports.
- [[entities/organizations/regional-authorities/index|Regional Authorities]] — Danish regions and municipal entities administering psychiatric healthcare, tracking diagnostic volumes, and managing cross-sectoral collaboration.
- [[entities/organizations/regions/index|Regions]] — Geographic and administrative regions serving as primary organizational units for psychiatric care, including national-level aggregates and specific regional authorities.
